scope: Resume rewrite-review API: bounded public service errors; same PR as resume editor error privacy
behavior: Only six documented PreparationError codes with an exact built-in string type are exposed with their existing HTTP statuses.
Unexpected, private, malformed or spoofed builder errors return fixed HTTP 500 RESUME_REWRITE_SERVICE_ERROR.
Known stale-context and validation errors, post-computation freshness rechecks, approved-fact review and protected-token response validation are preserved.
Read-only failures preserve reopened SQLite state, and real review succeeds after the injected failure is removed.
